text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both down 1.3% over the past day, holding steady near recent levels while smaller caps like Solana face sharper pressure. The Fear & Greed Index at 51 (Neutral) with a downward 7-day trend suggests market participants are cautiously hedging; Bitcoin's dominance at 60.1% indicates capital is rotating toward the largest assets rather than risk-on alts. Volume at $62B is moderate, consistent with a consolidation phase rather than capitulation or euphoria.
